summary.text: Joy Walters is a Democrat member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 4, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Caddo Parish. First elected in 2023, Joy Walters sits on the House and Governmental Affairs and Transportation, Highways and Public Works committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Joy Walters's occupation as executive researcher, with a B.A. from Wiley College, a Master of Divinity from Princeton Theological Seminary, and a Th.M. from Emory University.

The House page lists Joy Walters's committee assignments as House and Governmental Affairs, Transportation, Highways and Public Works, and House Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Democratic Caucus, Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus, and Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus.
